fusions.name: Pitch Past Hearing
fusions.desc: A croak pitched above hearing rolls 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in the cone, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Taken on the Wing
fusions.desc: Your tongue snaps at the first enemy in its path up to 6 tiles away, dealing 4 damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Flutter-Hop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Mouthful of Moths
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
